title: potentilla gaudinii f. prorepens
intro: Potentilla gaudinii f. prorepens, commonly known as a creeping five-spotted cinquefoil, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla gaudinii f. prorepens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
